description: On the tabletop there’s a yellow bottle, four plastic cups (yellow, red, green, and blue), and a blue scrub sponge lying in front. The right hand reaches forward and grips the red cup as a right-hand object, while the left hand moves left to pick up the yellow bottle and briefly angles its nozzle toward the red cup before setting the bottle back; then the left hand lifts the blue scrub sponge as a left-hand object and presses it into the mouth of the red cup, pushing and twisting slightly while the right hand holds the cup steady.
